# Linking Atlas orgs to marketplace billing accounts — facts

> Source-anchored units about Linking Atlas orgs to marketplace billing accounts: 12 across 4 sources. Each line ends in the URL and anchor it came from; `keywords:` names the lexicon terms that matched.

## How it works

- [statement] An unavailable organization Link button signals ineligibility; its hover tooltip supplies the reason. Each provider procedure allows creation of a new organization when none is available to link. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/aws-self-serve-marketplace.md · keywords: Linking Atlas orgs to marketplace billing accounts · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/azure-self-serve-marketplace.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/gcp-self-serve-marketplace.md
- [statement] A linked self-serve marketplace subscription disables editing the Atlas payment method; removing it requires unlinking through the marketplace cancellation flow. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/aws-self-serve-marketplace.md · keywords: Linking Atlas orgs to marketplace billing accounts · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/azure-self-serve-marketplace.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/gcp-self-serve-marketplace.md

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Atlas organizations in cross-organization billing cannot have or configure an active self-serve marketplace subscription; marketplace linking is therefore not a self-serve route to cross-organization billing consolidation. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/ · keywords: Linking Atlas orgs to marketplace billing accounts

## Facts and statements

- [statement] AWS and MongoDB both document Atlas pay-as-you-go procurement through AWS Marketplace; MongoDB distinguishes its self-serve subscription linking procedure from AWS Marketplace Contracts. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/migration-mongodb-atlas/costs-licenses.html · keywords: Linking Atlas orgs to marketplace billing accounts · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/aws-self-serve-marketplace.md
- [statement] For AWS, Azure and Google Cloud self-serve marketplace billing, subscribe in the cloud marketplace, complete its MongoDB account handoff, sign in to Atlas and explicitly link the intended Atlas organization. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/aws-self-serve-marketplace.md · keywords: Linking Atlas orgs to marketplace billing accounts · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/azure-self-serve-marketplace.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/gcp-self-serve-marketplace.md
- [statement] Resolve every outstanding or failed invoice in the Atlas organization before linking it to a cloud marketplace billing account. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/aws-self-serve-marketplace.md · keywords: Linking Atlas orgs to marketplace billing accounts · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/azure-self-serve-marketplace.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/gcp-self-serve-marketplace.md
- [statement] The marketplace handoff actions differ: AWS uses Set Up Your Account, Azure uses Configure account now, and Google Cloud uses Register With MongoDB after selecting the billing account during purchase. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/aws-self-serve-marketplace.md · keywords: Linking Atlas orgs to marketplace billing accounts · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/azure-self-serve-marketplace.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/gcp-self-serve-marketplace.md
- [statement] After organization selection, linking synchronizes asynchronously. The Atlas Payment Method field stays empty during synchronization and shows the provider-specific Marketplace Subscription value after success. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/aws-self-serve-marketplace.md · keywords: Linking Atlas orgs to marketplace billing accounts · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/azure-self-serve-marketplace.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/gcp-self-serve-marketplace.md
- [statement] With an AWS Marketplace Subscription, Atlas does not allow a credit card as backup payment. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/aws-self-serve-marketplace.md · keywords: Linking Atlas orgs to marketplace billing accounts
- [statement] Cancelling the AWS marketplace subscription unlinks its billing account but leaves Atlas resources and data in place, and resource charges continue; Microsoft separately documents that deleting the Atlas Azure resource stops marketplace billing without deleting the Atlas organization, projects or clusters. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-07-03) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/aws-self-serve-marketplace.md · keywords: Linking Atlas orgs to marketplace billing accounts · also: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/partner-solutions/mongo-db/create-projects-clusters
- [statement] Azure Native Integration provisioning creates a new Atlas organization under a selected Azure subscription and requires Azure Subscription Owner or Contributor access; the separate Azure self-serve marketplace procedure explicitly offers an existing-organization selection step. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-01-27) — https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/partner-solutions/mongo-db/create · keywords: Linking Atlas orgs to marketplace billing accounts · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/azure-self-serve-marketplace.md
- [statement] Two historical firsthand reports describe marketplace-to-Atlas handoff problems: a November 2022 GCP user did not receive the registration button after another person enabled the subscription, and an Azure user reported repeated redirects to signup. The GCP forum response directs the user to Atlas support; neither thread establishes a generally applicable technical fix. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/mongodb-atlas-api-on-gcloud-marketplace-not-referring-me-to-the-page-select-an-organization-to-link-to-your-gcp-billing-account/202208 · keywords: Linking Atlas orgs to marketplace billing accounts · also: https://www.reddit.com/r/mongodb/comments/v36l1v
